arabic text: BE JURM QATL HOGAYE SAJDE ME MURTAZA
english translation text: Jibraeel cries: what a calamity! Murtaza was killed without crime while in prostration.

arabic text: DUBI ALI KE KHOON ME KUFE KI HAI SAHAR\nZAKHMI HUWE HAI'N SAJDE ME, HASNAIN KE PIDAR\nMASJID ME FARSH E GHAM HAI, ALI KA BICHA HUWA
english translation text: Kufa's dawn is submerged in Ali's blood.\nThe father of Hasanayn was wounded in prostration.\nA mourning floor for Ali is spread within the mosque.

arabic text: BHOOLI ABHI KAHAA'N THI WHO MADAR KI PASLIYAAN\nROTI THI CHEEKH CHEEKH KAR HAIDER KI BETIYAN\nSAAYA SARO'N PE HAAYE YATEEMI KA CHAGAYA
english translation text: She had not yet forgotten her mother's broken ribs.\nHaider's daughters screamed and wept.\nThe shadow of orphanhood descended upon their heads.

arabic text: SHERE KHUDA KE ZAKHM SE RUKTA NAHI'N THA KHOON\nYEH DEKH KAR NABI HUW TURBAT ME BE SUKOON\nKEHTE THE SAR KO PEET KE SAARE HI AMBIYA
english translation text: Blood would not stop flowing from the Lion of God's wound.\nSeeing this, the Prophet became restless within his grave.\nAll the prophets beat their heads and cried:

arabic text: APNE LAHOO ME DOOB GAYA HAAYE ROZADAR\nKAISE LAEE'N NE KARDIYA SHERE KHUDA PE WAAR\nSAJDE SE SAR UTHA NA SAKA SHERE KIBRIYA
english translation text: Alas, the fasting one became immersed in his own blood.\nHow did the accursed one strike the Lion of God?\nThe Lion of the Almighty could not lift his head from prostration.

arabic text: EK YE KHABAR BHI LAAYI HAI UNEES KI SAHAR\nWEERAN HONE WAALA HAI AB SAYYADA KA GHAR\nSHERE KHUDA KA QATL HAI AAGHAAZ E KARBALA
english translation text: The dawn of the nineteenth brought this news:\nthe Sayyida's home is about to become desolate.\nThe killing of the Lion of God is the beginning of Karbala.

arabic text: IMDAAD KO GHAREEBO'N KI AB KAUN AAEGA\nAB KAUN IN GHAREEBO'N KO KHANA KHILAAEGA\nINKA MASEEHA QATL HUWA INKO KYA PATA
english translation text: Who will now come to help the poor?\nWho will now feed these helpless ones?\nTheir healer has been killed, yet they do not know.

arabic text: AB AUR LIKH NA PAAUNGA AZLAAN AZMI\nYAAD AA RAHI HAI MUJHKO BOHAT BABA JAAN KI\nIBNE ALI O ZAHRA MUJHE DENA HOSLA
english translation text: O Azlaan Azmi, I can write no more.\nI remember my father too deeply.\nO son of Ali and Zahra, grant me strength.
